publisher_checksum_note: No file digest is supplied on the inspected official download page; the captured SHA-256 identifies our local snapshot.

time_basis.observation: timestamp is documented as an integer Unix time. parent_asin is the key for product metadata; asin identifies the reviewed product or variant.

The dataset authors describe timestamp precision up to milliseconds. Combined with the integer Unix field and actual-file UTC/subsecond checks, this supports an epoch-millisecond mapping. Actual-file checks are recorded separately.
